fields.notes: Bluetooth Core v5.2 specifies an end-to-end Link Layer security model: pairing (SMP) → LTK → AES-CCM encryption → MIC verification + privacy (RPA). Above the LL, GATT supports authenticated + encrypted attribute access. Higher-layer profiles (LE Audio in 5.2) may layer additional content protection (e.g., LC3 frame encryption for broadcast audio). Bluetooth qualification requires FIPS-compliant LE Secure Connections for sensitive applications (medical, automotive).

ll_encryption_summary.algorithm: AES-128 in CCM (Counter with CBC-MAC) mode
ll_encryption_summary.key_derivation: Session Key = AES-128(LTK, SKD_combined) where SKD = SKDm || SKDs.

smp_pairing_methods.key_strength: no MITM protection; passive eavesdropper can derive STK in legacy pairing
20-bit entropy; LE Secure Connections version raises this via passkey-bit-by-bit confirmation
user verifies identical 6-digit number on both devices; LE Secure Connections only
OOB channel security; LE Secure Connections OOB exchanges r + ECDH PK over the OOB channel

le_secure_connections_summary.confirmation_method: f4 / f5 / f6 / g2 functions per spec

privacy_features: LE Privacy 1.0 (BLE 4.0)   — host-resolved Random Private Address (RPA).
LE Privacy 1.2 (BLE 4.2)    — full controller-resolved RPA + Resolving List in Controller for filtered scan/advertise.
Network Privacy (BLE 5.0)   — additional privacy controls in Extended Advertising.
Random Private Addresses rotated at configurable interval (default 15 minutes).
must_have_security_properties: AES-128 CCM encryption on every Link Layer PDU once encryption is established.
32-bit MIC appended to every encrypted PDU; failure terminates the connection with reason 0x3D 'MIC Failure'.
LE Secure Connections uses NIST P-256 ECDH for key exchange.
Just Works pairing must be explicitly accepted by both ends.
Privacy: Resolvable Private Address rotation prevents long-term tracking.
LL_PING_REQ / LL_PING_RSP provide an authenticated payload to detect MITM injection.
must_not_have_security_properties: Transmit unencrypted PDUs after a successful LL_START_ENC_RSP (encryption must remain active).
Reuse a packet counter (would break CCM nonce uniqueness).
Accept a Public Address from a peer claiming privacy via RPA.
Persist LTK across sessions if Bonding was not requested.
